intro.sr: Za velike ili teške artikle sistem ne može automatski da izračuna cenu dostave. Klijent odmah dobija samo informativni email da porudžbina čeka procenu - pravi email sa cenom i linkom za potvrdu stiže tek kad administrator unese stvarnu cenu dostave.
intro.en: For large or heavy items the system can't calculate shipping automatically. The customer immediately gets only an informational email that the order is pending a quote - the real email with the price and a confirm link only arrives once an admin enters the actual shipping cost.

prijava.sr: Klijent se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
prijava.en: The customer logs into their account.

otvaranje-stranice-proizvoda.en: The customer opens the page for a large/heavy item.

dodavanje-u-korpu.sr: Proizvod se dodaje u korpu na uobičajen način.
dodavanje-u-korpu.en: The product is added to the cart the usual way.

unos-podataka-za-dostavu.sr: Klijent unosi telefon i adresu, kao i kod obične porudžbine.
unos-podataka-za-dostavu.en: The customer enters a phone number and address, same as an ordinary order.

porudzbina-primljena.sr: Za razliku od standardne dostave, klijent ovde ne dobija link za potvrdu - samo obaveštenje da se cena dostave ručno izračunava i da će uskoro stići pravi email.
porudzbina-primljena.en: Unlike standard shipping, the customer doesn't get a confirm link here - just a notice that the shipping price is being calculated manually and a real email is coming soon.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje da bi obradio porudžbinu koja čeka procenu.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs in to process the order waiting on a quote.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom u gornjem desnom uglu.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name in the top-right corner.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.sr: Administrator bira „Admin panel” iz menija, čime se otvara admin deo sajta.
admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: The admin picks "Admin panel" from the menu, opening the site's admin area.

admin-privremene-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Prodavnica” u admin meniju.
admin-privremene-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Store" group in the admin menu.

admin-privremene-bira-stavku.sr: Administrator bira „Privremene porudžbine” - listu porudžbina koje još nisu potvrđene.
admin-privremene-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Pending orders" - the list of orders not yet confirmed.

admin-privremene-pretraga.sr: Administrator pretražuje po email adresi klijenta.
admin-privremene-pretraga.en: The admin searches by the customer's email.

admin-privremene-otvaranje-rezultata.sr: Administrator otvara porudžbinu i vidi da čeka procenu cene dostave.
admin-privremene-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin opens the order and sees it's waiting on a shipping quote.

admin-unosi-cenu-dostave.sr: Administrator unosi stvarnu cenu dostave (npr. na osnovu ponude prevoznika) i čuva je. Tek sada se klijentu šalje email sa konačnom cenom i radnim linkom za potvrdu.
admin-unosi-cenu-dostave.en: The admin enters the real shipping price (e.g. based on a carrier's quote) and saves it. Only now does the customer get an email with the final price and a working confirm link.

email-potvrde-sa-cenom.sr: Klijent klikom na link iz novog emaila (ovde simulirano direktnim otvaranjem linka) vidi konačnu cenu i potvrđuje porudžbinu.
email-potvrde-sa-cenom.en: The customer clicks the link from the new email (simulated here by opening the link directly), sees the final price, and confirms the order.
